subject: geography
title: What Makes a City Sustainable?
welcome_lead: Can cities be green? Discover what makes a sustainable city and why we need them.
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure introducing sustainable cities.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now define a sustainable city.

concepts.def: Meets needs now without harming the future.
City designed to last and protect the planet.
Amount of CO2 a person or city produces.
Energy from sources that don't run out.
Turning waste into new useful products.
Parks and natural areas in a city.

walkthroughs.body_html: A sustainable city works for people today without ruining the environment for tomorrow. It uses less energy, cuts waste, and protects nature.
Over half the world lives in cities, producing most CO₂ emissions. Making cities sustainable is vital to tackle climate change.
Sustainable cities have: renewable energy, good public transport, green spaces, recycling, affordable housing and walkable streets.
